blocks.text: SAN FRANCISCO, Agusan del Sur — Police operatives arrested a 47-year-old alleged drug peddler during an entrapment operation here on Friday night, October 23. Law enforcers also confiscated P68,000 worth of suspected crystal meth or “shabu,” and an unlicensed firearm. Major Carmelo Malubay, acting chief of police of the San Francisco Municipal Police Station, identified the suspect only by his alias, “Richard,” a resident of Purok 7, Barangay Alegria. Malubay said members of the station drug enforcement unit, in coordination with the Philippine Drug Enforcement Agency, cornered the suspect at around 10:22 p.m. in Purok 2, Barangay Karaos.
